note: GS건설 아파트 건설(골조·마감) PoC 카탈로그 — 토공(흙막이·굴착)/철근·거푸집/콘크리트 타설/비계·갱폼/타워크레인 양중/설비·전기·마감 6공종 특화. 한국 아파트 현장 중대재해 다발 유형(추락·붕괴·협착/충돌·질식·감전·화재) 반영. LG이노텍 반도체/팹/클린룸 콘텐츠 전면 제외. regulation 조문은 산업안전보건기준규칙(고용노동부령)을 국가법령정보센터(law.go.kr) 기준 2026-06-26 검증 완료. 주요 교정: 타워크레인 강풍 작업중지 §142→§37, 콘크리트 펌프카 §335, 줄걸이 안전계수 §166→§163, 낙하물 방지 §20→§14, 지하매설물 §341·§342.

EARTHWORK_EXCAVATION.label_vi: Đào đất & Chống vách hố đào
EARTHWORK_EXCAVATION.label_th: งานดินและงานขุด/กันดิน

baseline.content: 굴착면 기울기(구배) 기준 준수 및 토사 붕괴 위험 점검 — 지반 종류별 안식각 확인
baseline.content_en: Comply with excavation slope (gradient) standards and inspect soil collapse risk — verify angle of repose by soil type
baseline.content_vi: Tuân thủ tiêu chuẩn độ dốc mái đào và kiểm tra nguy cơ sạt lở — xác nhận góc nghỉ theo loại đất
baseline.content_th: ปฏิบัติตามมาตรฐานความลาดเอียงของหน้าขุดและตรวจสอบความเสี่ยงดินถล่ม — ตรวจสอบมุมพักตามชนิดดิน
baseline.content_id: Patuhi standar kemiringan galian dan periksa risiko longsor tanah — verifikasi sudut istirahat per jenis tanah
baseline.regulation: 산업안전보건기준규칙 §338(굴착면의 기울기 기준 — 별표11), §339(굴착면의 붕괴 등에 의한 위험방지)

scenarios.content: 강우·해빙으로 지반 약화 후 굴착면 구배 미준수 구간이 붕괴하여 하부 작업자 매몰
scenarios.content_en: After rain/thaw weakens ground, an over-steep excavation face collapses and buries workers below
scenarios.content_vi: Sau mưa/băng tan làm yếu đất, mái đào quá dốc sạt xuống vùi lấp công nhân bên dưới
scenarios.content_th: หลังฝน/น้ำแข็งละลายทำให้ดินอ่อน หน้าขุดที่ชันเกินไปพังลงมาทับผู้ปฏิบัติงานด้านล่าง
scenarios.content_id: Setelah hujan/pencairan melemahkan tanah, muka galian terlalu curam longsor dan menimbun pekerja di bawah

scenarios.content: 굴착 상부 끝단에 토사·자재를 적치하여 하중 증가로 굴착면 붕괴 유발
scenarios.content_en: Spoil/material stacked at the excavation crest adds surcharge and triggers face failure
scenarios.content_vi: Đất thải/vật liệu chất tại mép trên hố đào làm tăng tải gây sạt mái đào
scenarios.content_th: กองดิน/วัสดุที่ขอบบนหลุมขุดเพิ่มน้ำหนักทำให้หน้าขุดพัง
scenarios.content_id: Tanah buangan/material ditumpuk di tepi atas galian menambah beban dan memicu kelongsoran

mitigations.content: 지반 종류별 표준 구배 준수, 우천 후 굴착면 점검·계측, 상부 끝단 2m 이내 중량물 적치 금지
mitigations.content_en: Apply standard slope by soil type, inspect/monitor face after rain, ban heavy loads within 2m of crest
mitigations.content_vi: Áp dụng độ dốc chuẩn theo loại đất, kiểm tra mái sau mưa, cấm chất nặng trong 2m từ mép trên
mitigations.content_th: ใช้ความลาดมาตรฐานตามชนิดดิน ตรวจหน้าขุดหลังฝน ห้ามวางของหนักในระยะ 2 ม.จากขอบบน
mitigations.content_id: Terapkan kemiringan standar per jenis tanah, periksa muka setelah hujan, larang beban berat dalam 2m dari tepi

mitigations.content: 굴착 깊이 1.5m 이상 또는 붕괴 우려 시 흙막이 지보공 설치, 하부 작업자 출입 최소화
mitigations.content_en: Install earth retaining support when depth ≥1.5m or collapse risk; minimize worker entry below
mitigations.content_vi: Lắp kết cấu chống vách khi sâu ≥1.5m hoặc có nguy cơ sạt; hạn chế công nhân xuống dưới
mitigations.content_th: ติดตั้งระบบกันดินเมื่อลึก ≥1.5 ม.หรือเสี่ยงพัง ลดการเข้าทำงานด้านล่าง
mitigations.content_id: Pasang penahan tanah saat kedalaman ≥1.5m atau berisiko longsor; minimalkan pekerja di bawah

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + hi-vis vest
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + áo phản quang
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + rompi hi-vis

baseline.content: 흙막이 지보공(엄지말뚝·띠장·버팀보) 설치 상태 및 계측관리 확인
baseline.content_en: Verify earth retaining support (soldier pile/wale/strut) installation and instrumentation monitoring
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra lắp đặt kết cấu chống vách (cọc/dầm vây/thanh chống) và quan trắc
baseline.content_th: ตรวจสอบการติดตั้งระบบกันดิน (เสาเข็ม/คานรัด/ค้ำยัน) และการตรวจวัด
baseline.content_id: Verifikasi pemasangan penahan tanah (soldier pile/wale/strut) dan pemantauan instrumentasi

scenarios.content: 버팀보·띠장 연결부 변형·이완을 방치하여 흙막이 벽체 붕괴, 인접 도로·건물 침하
scenarios.content_en: Neglected deformation/loosening at strut-wale joints causes retaining wall failure and adjacent settlement
scenarios.content_vi: Bỏ qua biến dạng/lỏng tại liên kết thanh chống làm tường chắn sập và lún công trình lân cận
scenarios.content_th: ละเลยการเสียรูป/หลวมที่จุดต่อค้ำยันทำให้กำแพงกันดินพังและทรุดข้างเคียง
scenarios.content_id: Deformasi/kelonggaran sambungan strut diabaikan menyebabkan dinding penahan runtuh dan penurunan sekitar

mitigations.content: 지중경사계·하중계·지하수위계 정기 계측 및 관리기준치 초과 시 작업중지, 일일 육안점검 기록
mitigations.content_en: Routine inclinometer/load cell/water-level monitoring; stop work if thresholds exceeded; daily visual log
mitigations.content_vi: Quan trắc nghiêng kế/tải trọng/mực nước định kỳ; dừng việc nếu vượt ngưỡng; ghi nhật ký kiểm tra hằng ngày
mitigations.content_th: ตรวจวัด inclinometer/load cell/ระดับน้ำเป็นประจำ หยุดงานเมื่อเกินค่ากำหนด บันทึกตรวจสายตาทุกวัน
mitigations.content_id: Pemantauan inklinometer/load cell/muka air rutin; hentikan kerja jika melampaui batas; catat inspeksi visual harian

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + hi-vis vest
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + áo phản quang
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + rompi hi-vis

baseline.content: 굴착 건설기계(백호·로더) 작업반경 내 출입통제 및 신호수 배치 확인
baseline.content_en: Control entry into excavation machine (backhoe/loader) swing radius and confirm signal person
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm soát ra vào bán kính máy đào (backhoe/loader) và bố trí người ra hiệu
baseline.content_th: ควบคุมการเข้าในรัศมีทำงานของเครื่องจักรขุด (แบ็คโฮ/โหลดเดอร์) และจัดผู้ให้สัญญาณ
baseline.content_id: Kendalikan akses dalam radius alat gali (backhoe/loader) dan tetapkan pemberi aba-aba

scenarios.content: 백호 선회 중 사각지대에 있던 보행 작업자가 버킷·차체에 협착·충돌
scenarios.content_en: Worker in blind spot is struck/crushed by bucket or body while backhoe swings
scenarios.content_vi: Công nhân trong điểm mù bị gàu/thân máy va đập/kẹp khi backhoe quay
scenarios.content_th: ผู้ปฏิบัติงานในจุดบอดถูกบุ้งกี๋/ตัวรถชน/หนีบขณะแบ็คโฮหมุน
scenarios.content_id: Pekerja di titik buta tertabrak/terjepit bucket atau bodi saat backhoe berputar

mitigations.content: 작업반경 출입금지 라인·콘 설치, 전담 신호수 배치, 후방감지기·경광등 작동 확인, 보행로 분리
mitigations.content_en: Set exclusion line/cones in swing radius, assign dedicated signaler, verify rear sensor/beacon, separate walkway
mitigations.content_vi: Lập rào/cọc cấm trong bán kính, cử người ra hiệu chuyên trách, kiểm tra cảm biến lùi/đèn báo, tách lối đi bộ
mitigations.content_th: ตั้งแนวห้ามเข้า/กรวยในรัศมี จัดผู้ให้สัญญาณเฉพาะ ตรวจเซ็นเซอร์ถอย/ไฟหมุน แยกทางเดิน
mitigations.content_id: Pasang garis/kerucut larangan dalam radius, tugaskan pemberi aba-aba khusus, cek sensor mundur/lampu rotari, pisahkan jalur pejalan

ppe.content: 안전모 + 안전화 + 고시인성 안전조끼(신호수 별도 색상)
ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + hi-vis vest (distinct color for signaler)
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + áo phản quang (màu riêng cho người ra hiệu)
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง (สีต่างหากสำหรับผู้ให้สัญญาณ)
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + rompi hi-vis (warna khusus untuk pemberi aba-aba)

baseline.content: 지하 매설물(가스·전력·통신·상하수) 사전 확인 및 굴착 단부 추락방지 조치
baseline.content_en: Pre-check underground utilities (gas/power/comms/water) and provide fall protection at excavation edge
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra trước hạ tầng ngầm (gas/điện/viễn thông/nước) và chống rơi tại mép hố đào
baseline.content_th: ตรวจสอบสาธารณูปโภคใต้ดิน (ก๊าซ/ไฟฟ้า/สื่อสาร/น้ำ) ล่วงหน้าและป้องกันตกที่ขอบหลุมขุด
baseline.content_id: Periksa utilitas bawah tanah (gas/listrik/komunikasi/air) lebih awal dan proteksi jatuh di tepi galian
baseline.regulation: 산업안전보건기준규칙 §341(매설물 등 파손에 의한 위험방지), §342(굴착기계등에 의한 지하 공작물 손괴 방지), §13(안전난간)

scenarios.content: 도면·탐사 없이 굴착 중 가스·전력 매설관 손상으로 폭발·감전 발생
scenarios.content_en: Digging without drawings/survey damages buried gas/power line causing explosion/electrocution
scenarios.content_vi: Đào không có bản vẽ/khảo sát làm hỏng ống gas/điện ngầm gây nổ/điện giật
scenarios.content_th: ขุดโดยไม่มีแบบ/สำรวจทำให้ท่อก๊าซ/สายไฟใต้ดินเสียหายเกิดระเบิด/ไฟดูด
scenarios.content_id: Menggali tanpa gambar/survei merusak pipa gas/kabel listrik bawah tanah menyebabkan ledakan/sengatan

scenarios.content: 굴착 단부에 안전난간·방호울 미설치로 야간·우천 시 작업자·차량 추락
scenarios.content_en: Worker/vehicle falls into excavation at night/rain due to missing edge guardrail/barrier
scenarios.content_vi: Công nhân/xe rơi xuống hố đào ban đêm/khi mưa do thiếu lan can/rào mép
scenarios.content_th: ผู้ปฏิบัติงาน/รถตกลงในหลุมขุดตอนกลางคืน/ฝนตกเพราะไม่มีราวกัน/แผงกั้นขอบ
scenarios.content_id: Pekerja/kendaraan jatuh ke galian saat malam/hujan karena tidak ada railing/barrier tepi

mitigations.content: 굴착 전 매설물 도면 확인·지중탐사(GPR)·시험굴착, 가스·전력사 입회, 인력굴착 병행
mitigations.content_en: Pre-dig utility drawing check/GPR survey/trial pit, attendance of gas-power utility, supplement with hand digging
mitigations.content_vi: Kiểm tra bản vẽ/khảo sát GPR/đào thử trước, có đơn vị gas-điện chứng kiến, kết hợp đào thủ công
mitigations.content_th: ตรวจแบบสาธารณูปโภค/สำรวจ GPR/ขุดทดสอบก่อน มีหน่วยก๊าซ-ไฟฟ้าร่วม ขุดด้วยมือเสริม
mitigations.content_id: Cek gambar utilitas/survei GPR/galian uji sebelum, dihadiri unit gas-listrik, lengkapi galian manual

mitigations.content: 굴착 단부 전 구간 안전난간·방호울·야간 경광등 설치, 차량 접근 스토퍼 배치
mitigations.content_en: Install guardrail/barrier/night beacon along all excavation edges; place vehicle wheel stoppers
mitigations.content_vi: Lắp lan can/rào/đèn báo đêm dọc toàn bộ mép hố; đặt chặn bánh xe
mitigations.content_th: ติดราวกัน/แผงกั้น/ไฟเตือนกลางคืนตลอดขอบหลุม วางที่กั้นล้อรถ
mitigations.content_id: Pasang railing/barrier/lampu malam di seluruh tepi galian; pasang penahan roda kendaraan

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + hi-vis vest + (night) luminous band
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + áo phản quang + (ban đêm) băng phát sáng
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง + (กลางคืน) แถบเรืองแสง
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + rompi hi-vis + (malam) pita bercahaya

REBAR_FORMWORK.label_th: งานเหล็กเสริมและแบบหล่อ

baseline.content: 거푸집 동바리 설치 기준(수직도·간격·연결재·수평연결) 및 좌굴·붕괴 위험 점검
baseline.content_en: Inspect formwork shoring standards (verticality/spacing/ties/horizontal bracing) and buckling/collapse risk
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra tiêu chuẩn cây chống ván khuôn (độ thẳng/khoảng cách/giằng) và nguy cơ oằn/sập
baseline.content_th: ตรวจมาตรฐานค้ำยันแบบหล่อ (ความดิ่ง/ระยะ/ตัวยึด/ค้ำแนวนอน) และความเสี่ยงโก่ง/พัง
baseline.content_id: Periksa standar perancah bekisting (vertikalitas/jarak/pengikat/bracing) dan risiko tekuk/runtuh

scenarios.content: 동바리 수평연결재 누락·편심으로 슬래브 거푸집이 좌굴 붕괴하여 상·하부 작업자 매몰
scenarios.content_en: Missing horizontal bracing/eccentricity buckles slab formwork, burying workers above and below
scenarios.content_vi: Thiếu giằng ngang/lệch tâm làm ván khuôn sàn oằn sập, vùi công nhân trên dưới
scenarios.content_th: ขาดค้ำแนวนอน/เยื้องศูนย์ทำให้แบบพื้นโก่งพังทับผู้ปฏิบัติงานบน-ล่าง
scenarios.content_id: Bracing horizontal hilang/eksentris membuat bekisting pelat tekuk runtuh, menimbun pekerja atas-bawah

mitigations.content: 구조검토된 동바리 배치도 준수, 수평연결재 2방향 설치, U헤드·잭베이스 밀착, 타설 전 검측·합격 후 작업
mitigations.content_en: Follow engineered shoring layout, install bi-directional bracing, seat U-head/jack base, inspect & pass before pour
mitigations.content_vi: Theo bản bố trí cây chống đã tính, lắp giằng 2 phương, kê U-head/jack base, nghiệm thu trước khi đổ
mitigations.content_th: ทำตามผังค้ำยันที่คำนวณ ติดค้ำ 2 ทิศ รองหัว U/jack base ตรวจรับก่อนเทคอนกรีต
mitigations.content_id: Ikuti tata letak perancah terhitung, pasang bracing 2 arah, dudukkan U-head/jack base, inspeksi lulus sebelum cor

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + harness (height) + work gloves
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + dây an toàn (trên cao) + găng tay
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เข็มขัดนิรภัย (ที่สูง) + ถุงมือ
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + harness (ketinggian) + sarung tangan

baseline.content: 철근 조립 고소작업 시 작업발판·단부/개구부 추락방지 및 안전난간 확인
baseline.content_en: Verify work platform and edge/opening fall protection and guardrails during rebar work at height
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra sàn thao tác và chống rơi tại mép/lỗ mở và lan can khi lắp cốt thép trên cao
baseline.content_th: ตรวจสอบนั่งร้าน/พื้นทำงานและการป้องกันตกที่ขอบ/ช่องเปิดและราวกันตกขณะผูกเหล็กที่สูง
baseline.content_id: Verifikasi platform kerja dan proteksi jatuh tepi/lubang dan railing saat pembesian di ketinggian

scenarios.content: 슬래브 단부·개구부에 난간·덮개 미설치 상태에서 철근 배근 중 추락
scenarios.content_en: Worker falls during rebar placement where slab edge/opening lacks guardrail/cover
scenarios.content_vi: Công nhân ngã khi đặt cốt thép tại mép/lỗ sàn thiếu lan can/nắp
scenarios.content_th: ผู้ปฏิบัติงานตกขณะวางเหล็กที่ขอบ/ช่องเปิดพื้นซึ่งไม่มีราว/ฝาปิด
scenarios.content_id: Pekerja jatuh saat pembesian di tepi/lubang pelat tanpa railing/penutup

scenarios.content: 수직으로 노출된 철근 위로 추락하여 관통상(찔림) 발생
scenarios.content_en: Fall onto exposed vertical rebar causes impalement injury
scenarios.content_vi: Ngã lên cốt thép đứng lộ ra gây xuyên thủng
scenarios.content_th: ตกลงบนเหล็กเสริมแนวตั้งที่โผล่ทำให้ถูกเสียบทะลุ
scenarios.content_id: Jatuh ke besi tegak yang terbuka menyebabkan luka tertusuk

mitigations.content: 단부 안전난간·개구부 덮개(고정식)·추락방호망 설치, 노출 철근 캡(머시룸캡) 씌움, 안전대 부착설비 확보
mitigations.content_en: Install edge guardrail/fixed opening cover/safety net, fit rebar end caps (mushroom), provide harness anchor
mitigations.content_vi: Lắp lan can mép/nắp lỗ cố định/lưới chống rơi, chụp đầu cốt thép (mushroom cap), bố trí điểm neo dây an toàn
mitigations.content_th: ติดราวขอบ/ฝาปิดช่องเปิดแบบยึด/ตาข่ายกันตก ครอบปลายเหล็ก (mushroom cap) จัดจุดยึดเข็มขัดนิรภัย
mitigations.content_id: Pasang railing tepi/penutup lubang tetap/jaring pengaman, pasang cap ujung besi (mushroom), sediakan anchor harness

ppe.content: 안전모 + 안전화 + 전신 안전대(2점 후크) + 철근작업용 장갑
ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + full-body harness (double hook) + rebar gloves
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + dây an toàn toàn thân (móc đôi) + găng làm cốt thép
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เข็มขัดนิรภัยเต็มตัว (ตะขอคู่) + ถุงมืองานเหล็ก
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + full body harness (hook ganda) + sarung tangan pembesian

baseline.content: 철근·거푸집 자재 인양 및 운반 시 낙하·협착 방지(인양 결속·하부 통제)
baseline.content_en: Prevent drop/crush during rebar/formwork material lifting and handling (rigging/exclusion below)
baseline.content_vi: Ngăn rơi/kẹp khi nâng và vận chuyển cốt thép/ván khuôn (buộc tải/cấm dưới)
baseline.content_th: ป้องกันการตก/หนีบขณะยกและขนย้ายเหล็ก/แบบหล่อ (การผูกรัด/ควบคุมด้านล่าง)
baseline.content_id: Cegah jatuh/terjepit saat mengangkat dan memindah besi/bekisting (rigging/larangan di bawah)

scenarios.content: 철근 다발 결속 불량으로 인양 중 낙하하여 하부 작업자 충돌·협착
scenarios.content_en: Poorly slung rebar bundle drops during lift, striking/crushing workers below
scenarios.content_vi: Bó cốt thép buộc kém rơi khi nâng, va/kẹp công nhân bên dưới
scenarios.content_th: มัดเหล็กผูกไม่ดีตกขณะยก ชน/หนีบผู้ปฏิบัติงานด้านล่าง
scenarios.content_id: Ikatan bundel besi buruk jatuh saat diangkat, menabrak/menjepit pekerja di bawah

mitigations.content: 정격 슬링·샤클 사용·2점 이상 균형 결속, 인양 하부 출입통제, 유도로프로 흔들림 제어, 신호수 1인 전담
mitigations.content_en: Use rated sling/shackle with ≥2-point balanced rigging, exclude area below, control swing with tag line, dedicate one signaler
mitigations.content_vi: Dùng cáp/ma ní định mức buộc cân ≥2 điểm, cấm vùng dưới, dùng dây dẫn hướng, 1 người ra hiệu chuyên trách
mitigations.content_th: ใช้สลิง/สเก็นพิกัด ผูกสมดุล ≥2 จุด ห้ามเข้าด้านล่าง ใช้เชือกนำควบคุมการแกว่ง ผู้ให้สัญญาณ 1 คน
mitigations.content_id: Gunakan sling/shackle berperingkat, rigging seimbang ≥2 titik, larang area bawah, kendalikan ayunan dengan tag line, 1 pemberi aba-aba

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + work gloves + hi-vis vest
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + găng tay + áo phản quang
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + ถุงมือ + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + sarung tangan + rompi hi-vis

CONCRETE_POUR.label_th: งานเทคอนกรีต

baseline.content: 타설 중 거푸집 동바리 변형·침하 실시간 감시 및 붕괴 징후 시 즉시 대피
baseline.content_en: Real-time monitoring of formwork shoring deformation/settlement during pour; evacuate immediately on collapse signs
baseline.content_vi: Giám sát thời gian thực biến dạng/lún cây chống khi đổ; sơ tán ngay khi có dấu hiệu sập
baseline.content_th: เฝ้าระวังการเสียรูป/ทรุดของค้ำยันแบบเรียลไทม์ขณะเท อพยพทันทีเมื่อมีสัญญาณพัง
baseline.content_id: Pantau real-time deformasi/penurunan perancah saat cor; evakuasi segera saat ada tanda runtuh

scenarios.content: 집중 타설로 국부 하중 초과 → 동바리 침하·붕괴로 콘크리트와 함께 작업자 매몰
scenarios.content_en: Concentrated pour exceeds local load → shoring settles/collapses, burying workers with concrete
scenarios.content_vi: Đổ tập trung vượt tải cục bộ → cây chống lún/sập, vùi công nhân cùng bê tông
scenarios.content_th: เทกระจุกเกินน้ำหนักเฉพาะจุด → ค้ำยันทรุด/พังทับผู้ปฏิบัติงานพร้อมคอนกรีต
scenarios.content_id: Cor terpusat melampaui beban lokal → perancah turun/runtuh, menimbun pekerja bersama beton

mitigations.content: 타설 순서·속도·1회 타설고 준수(분산 타설), 동바리 전담 감시자 배치, 이상 시 타설 중단·대피 신호 사전 약속
mitigations.content_en: Follow pour sequence/rate/lift height (distributed pour), assign shoring watcher, pre-agree stop/evacuate signal
mitigations.content_vi: Tuân thủ trình tự/tốc độ/chiều cao mỗi lớp (đổ phân tán), cử người giám sát cây chống, thống nhất tín hiệu dừng/sơ tán
mitigations.content_th: ทำตามลำดับ/อัตรา/ความสูงต่อชั้นการเท (เทกระจาย) จัดผู้เฝ้าค้ำยัน ตกลงสัญญาณหยุด/อพยพล่วงหน้า
mitigations.content_id: Ikuti urutan/laju/tinggi per lapis cor (cor terdistribusi), tugaskan pengawas perancah, sepakati sinyal stop/evakuasi

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + rubber safety boots + alkali-resistant gloves + safety goggles
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + ủng cao su bảo hộ + găng chống kiềm + kính bảo hộ
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้าบูทยางนิรภัย + ถุงมือกันด่าง + แว่นตานิรภัย
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu boot karet + sarung tangan tahan alkali + kacamata safety

baseline.content: 콘크리트 펌프카 설치(아웃트리거·지반보강) 및 붐·고압 호스 취급 안전 확인
baseline.content_en: Verify concrete pump truck setup (outriggers/ground support) and boom/high-pressure hose handling
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra lắp đặt xe bơm bê tông (chân chống/gia cố nền) và xử lý cần/ống áp lực cao
baseline.content_th: ตรวจการตั้งรถปั๊มคอนกรีต (ขาค้ำ/เสริมพื้น) และการจัดการบูม/ท่อแรงดันสูง
baseline.content_id: Verifikasi setup truk pompa beton (outrigger/perkuatan tanah) dan penanganan boom/selang tekanan tinggi
baseline.regulation: 산업안전보건기준규칙 §335(콘크리트 펌프·펌프카 사용 시 준수사항 — 아웃트리거 침하·전도 방지), §334(콘크리트 타설작업)

scenarios.content: 아웃트리거 받침 지반 침하로 펌프카 전도, 붐이 인접 작업자·가공전선 방향으로 도괴
scenarios.content_en: Outrigger ground settles, pump truck tips over, boom collapses toward workers/overhead lines
scenarios.content_vi: Nền chân chống lún, xe bơm lật, cần đổ về phía công nhân/đường dây trên không
scenarios.content_th: พื้นรองขาค้ำทรุด รถปั๊มล้ม บูมล้มไปทางผู้ปฏิบัติงาน/สายไฟเหนือศีรษะ
scenarios.content_id: Tanah outrigger turun, truk pompa terguling, boom roboh ke arah pekerja/kabel atas

scenarios.content: 압송관 막힘 후 고압 해소 과정에서 호스가 튀어(whip) 작업자 가격
scenarios.content_en: After line blockage, releasing high pressure whips the hose and strikes a worker
scenarios.content_vi: Sau khi tắc ống, xả áp cao làm ống vung (whip) đập trúng công nhân
scenarios.content_th: หลังท่ออุดตัน การปล่อยแรงดันสูงทำให้ท่อสะบัดฟาดผู้ปฏิบัติงาน
scenarios.content_id: Setelah pipa tersumbat, pelepasan tekanan tinggi membuat selang menyabet pekerja

mitigations.content: 아웃트리거 전개 시 받침목·철판 보강·지반 지지력 확인, 가공전선 이격(이격거리·방호관), 작업반경 출입통제
mitigations.content_en: On outrigger deployment use pads/plates, verify bearing capacity, keep clearance from overhead lines (insulating guard), exclude swing radius
mitigations.content_vi: Khi mở chân chống dùng đệm/tấm thép, kiểm tra sức chịu nền, giữ khoảng cách đường dây (ống bọc), cấm vào bán kính
mitigations.content_th: เมื่อกางขาค้ำใช้แผ่นรอง/แผ่นเหล็ก ตรวจกำลังรับน้ำหนัก เว้นระยะสายไฟ (ปลอกหุ้ม) ห้ามเข้ารัศมี
mitigations.content_id: Saat memasang outrigger gunakan pad/pelat, verifikasi daya dukung, jaga jarak kabel atas (selubung), larang radius ayun

mitigations.content: 압송관 막힘 시 펌프 정지·압력 완전 해소 후 분해, 호스 끝단 고정·작업자 정면 위치 금지
mitigations.content_en: On blockage, stop pump and fully release pressure before opening line; secure hose end, ban standing in line of hose
mitigations.content_vi: Khi tắc, dừng bơm và xả hết áp trước khi tháo; cố định đầu ống, cấm đứng trước hướng ống
mitigations.content_th: เมื่ออุดตัน หยุดปั๊มและปล่อยแรงดันหมดก่อนถอด ยึดปลายท่อ ห้ามยืนหน้าท่อ
mitigations.content_id: Saat tersumbat, hentikan pompa dan lepas tekanan penuh sebelum membuka; amankan ujung selang, larang berdiri segaris selang

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + safety goggles + hi-vis vest
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + ủng bảo hộ + kính bảo hộ + áo phản quang
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้าบูทนิรภัย + แว่นตานิรภัย + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu boot safety + kacamata safety + rompi hi-vis

baseline.content: 타설 작업발판·단부 추락방지 및 진동기(바이브레이터) 감전 예방 확인
baseline.content_en: Verify pour platform/edge fall protection and vibrator electric shock prevention
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra sàn thao tác/chống rơi mép và phòng điện giật khi dùng đầm dùi
baseline.content_th: ตรวจนั่งร้าน/ป้องกันตกขอบและป้องกันไฟดูดจากเครื่องสั่นคอนกรีต
baseline.content_id: Verifikasi platform/proteksi jatuh tepi dan pencegahan sengatan listrik vibrator

scenarios.content: 젖은 발판·단부에서 진동기 호스에 걸려 미끄러져 단부로 추락
scenarios.content_en: Worker trips on vibrator hose on wet platform/edge and falls off the edge
scenarios.content_vi: Công nhân vướng ống đầm trên sàn/mép ướt trượt ngã khỏi mép
scenarios.content_th: ผู้ปฏิบัติงานสะดุดสายเครื่องสั่นบนพื้น/ขอบเปียกลื่นตกจากขอบ
scenarios.content_id: Pekerja tersandung selang vibrator di platform/tepi basah dan jatuh dari tepi

scenarios.content: 진동기 전선 피복 손상·물기 접촉으로 감전
scenarios.content_en: Damaged vibrator cable insulation contacts water causing electric shock
scenarios.content_vi: Vỏ cách điện dây đầm hỏng tiếp xúc nước gây điện giật
scenarios.content_th: ฉนวนสายเครื่องสั่นชำรุดสัมผัสน้ำทำให้ไฟดูด
scenarios.content_id: Isolasi kabel vibrator rusak terkena air menyebabkan sengatan listrik

mitigations.content: 작업발판 폭·고정 확보·단부 난간 유지, 진동기 누전차단기(ELB) 경유·접지·전선 피복 점검, 정리정돈
mitigations.content_en: Ensure platform width/fixing and edge guardrail; route vibrator via ELB with grounding, check cable insulation, housekeeping
mitigations.content_vi: Đảm bảo bề rộng/cố định sàn và lan can mép; đầm qua ELB có tiếp địa, kiểm tra vỏ dây, dọn dẹp
mitigations.content_th: จัดความกว้าง/ยึดนั่งร้านและราวขอบ ต่อเครื่องสั่นผ่าน ELB มีสายดิน ตรวจฉนวน เก็บกวาด
mitigations.content_id: Pastikan lebar/pengikatan platform dan railing tepi; vibrator lewat ELB dengan grounding, cek isolasi, housekeeping

ppe.content: 안전모 + 절연 안전장화 + 안전대 + 절연장갑(진동기 취급)
ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + insulated rubber boots + harness + insulating gloves (vibrator handling)
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + ủng cách điện + dây an toàn + găng cách điện (khi dùng đầm)
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้าบูทฉนวน + เข็มขัดนิรภัย + ถุงมือฉนวน (ใช้เครื่องสั่น)
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu boot isolasi + harness + sarung tangan isolasi (penanganan vibrator)

SCAFFOLD_GANGFORM.label_th: นั่งร้านและแบบเกงฟอร์ม

baseline.content: 시스템비계 작업발판 전면 설치·고정 및 안전난간(상·중)·발끝막이판 확인
baseline.content_en: Verify full-coverage system scaffold platform/fixing and guardrails (top/mid) and toe board
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra sàn giàn giáo hệ phủ kín/cố định và lan can (trên/giữa) và tấm chắn chân
baseline.content_th: ตรวจพื้นนั่งร้านระบบเต็มพื้นที่/ยึดและราวกัน (บน/กลาง) และแผ่นกันของตก
baseline.content_id: Verifikasi platform perancah sistem penuh/pengikatan dan railing (atas/tengah) dan toe board

scenarios.content: 작업발판 일부 미설치·고정 불량으로 발판이 들리거나 빠져 작업자 추락
scenarios.content_en: Partially missing/poorly fixed platform lifts or dislodges, causing a fall
scenarios.content_vi: Sàn lắp thiếu/cố định kém bị bật hoặc tuột làm công nhân ngã
scenarios.content_th: พื้นทำงานติดตั้งไม่ครบ/ยึดไม่ดี กระดกหรือหลุดทำให้ตก
scenarios.content_id: Platform sebagian hilang/ikatan buruk terangkat atau lepas menyebabkan jatuh

mitigations.content: 발판 틈새 최소화·양단 고정(긴결), 상부·중간 난간 및 발끝막이판 전 구간 설치, 비계 정기점검 태그
mitigations.content_en: Minimize gaps/fix both ends of planks, install top/mid rails and toe boards throughout, scaffold inspection tag
mitigations.content_vi: Giảm khe hở/cố định 2 đầu ván, lắp lan can trên/giữa và tấm chắn chân toàn tuyến, thẻ kiểm tra giàn giáo
mitigations.content_th: ลดช่องว่าง/ยึดปลายแผ่นทั้งสอง ติดราวบน/กลางและแผ่นกันของตกตลอด ติดป้ายตรวจนั่งร้าน
mitigations.content_id: Minimalkan celah/ikat kedua ujung papan, pasang railing atas/tengah dan toe board menyeluruh, tag inspeksi perancah

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + full-body harness
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + dây an toàn toàn thân
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เข็มขัดนิรภัยเต็มตัว
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + full body harness

baseline.content: 갱폼 인양·설치·해체 시 추락·낙하 방지(인양고리·케이지·하부 통제)
baseline.content_en: Prevent fall/drop during gang form lifting/installation/dismantling (lift lugs/cage/exclusion below)
baseline.content_vi: Ngăn rơi/ngã khi nâng/lắp/tháo gang form (móc nâng/lồng thao tác/cấm dưới)
baseline.content_th: ป้องกันตก/ของตกขณะยก/ติดตั้ง/รื้อเกงฟอร์ม (หูยก/กรง/ควบคุมด้านล่าง)
baseline.content_id: Cegah jatuh/terjatuh saat angkat/pasang/bongkar gang form (lug angkat/cage/larangan bawah)

scenarios.content: 갱폼 인양고리 용접부 균열·과하중으로 인양 중 갱폼 추락하여 하부 작업자·통행인 가격
scenarios.content_en: Cracked/overloaded gang form lift lug fails, dropping the form onto workers/passers-by below
scenarios.content_vi: Móc nâng gang form nứt/quá tải hỏng, gang form rơi trúng người bên dưới
scenarios.content_th: หูยกเกงฟอร์มร้าว/รับเกินพิกัดขาด เกงฟอร์มตกใส่คนด้านล่าง
scenarios.content_id: Lug angkat gang form retak/kelebihan beban gagal, form jatuh menimpa orang di bawah

scenarios.content: 갱폼 케이지 안전대 미체결 상태에서 외부 작업 중 추락
scenarios.content_en: Worker on outer gang form work falls with harness not connected in the cage
scenarios.content_vi: Công nhân làm bên ngoài gang form ngã do chưa móc dây an toàn trong lồng
scenarios.content_th: ผู้ปฏิบัติงานด้านนอกเกงฟอร์มตกเพราะไม่ได้คล้องเข็มขัดในกรง
scenarios.content_id: Pekerja di sisi luar gang form jatuh karena harness tidak terkait di cage

mitigations.content: 인양고리 용접부 비파괴·육안 점검, 정격하중 준수, 강풍 시 인양중지, 하부 출입통제·낙하물 방호선반
mitigations.content_en: NDT/visual check of lift lug welds, observe rated load, stop lifting in high wind, exclude below + catch platform
mitigations.content_vi: Kiểm tra NDT/bằng mắt mối hàn móc nâng, theo tải định mức, ngừng nâng khi gió mạnh, cấm dưới + sàn hứng
mitigations.content_th: ตรวจ NDT/สายตารอยเชื่อมหูยก ทำตามพิกัด หยุดยกเมื่อลมแรง ห้ามเข้าด้านล่าง + ชั้นรับของตก
mitigations.content_id: Cek NDT/visual las lug angkat, patuhi beban rating, hentikan angkat saat angin kencang, larang bawah + catch platform

mitigations.content: 갱폼 케이지 내부 수직구명줄·안전대 100% 체결, 작업 전 케이지 고정상태 확인
mitigations.content_en: 100% harness tie-off to vertical lifeline in cage, verify cage anchorage before work
mitigations.content_vi: Móc dây an toàn 100% vào dây cứu sinh đứng trong lồng, kiểm tra neo lồng trước khi làm
mitigations.content_th: คล้องเข็มขัด 100% กับไลฟ์ไลน์แนวตั้งในกรง ตรวจการยึดกรงก่อนทำงาน
mitigations.content_id: Tie-off harness 100% ke lifeline vertikal di cage, verifikasi penambatan cage sebelum kerja

ppe.content: 안전모(턱끈) + 안전화 + 전신 안전대(2점 후크) + 보호장갑
ppe.content_en: Safety helmet (chin strap) + safety boots + full-body harness (double hook) + gloves
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ (quai cằm) + giày bảo hộ + dây an toàn toàn thân (móc đôi) + găng tay
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย (สายรัดคาง) + รองเท้านิรภัย + เข็มขัดนิรภัยเต็มตัว (ตะขอคู่) + ถุงมือ
ppe.content_id: Helm safety (tali dagu) + sepatu safety + full body harness (hook ganda) + sarung tangan

baseline.content: 비계 조립·해체 작업 시 단계별 안전대 부착·자재 인양 및 동시작업 통제
baseline.content_en: Control harness tie-off, material lifting and concurrent work during scaffold erection/dismantling
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm soát móc dây an toàn, nâng vật liệu và làm việc đồng thời khi lắp/tháo giàn giáo
baseline.content_th: ควบคุมการคล้องเข็มขัด การยกวัสดุและงานพร้อมกันขณะประกอบ/รื้อนั่งร้าน
baseline.content_id: Kendalikan tie-off harness, angkat material dan kerja serentak saat pasang/bongkar perancah
baseline.regulation: 산업안전보건기준규칙 §57(비계 등의 조립·해체 및 변경), §59(강관비계 조립 시의 준수사항)

scenarios.content: 발판 미설치 단계의 비계 조립·해체 중 안전대 미체결로 작업자 추락
scenarios.content_en: During scaffold erect/dismantle without platform, worker falls with harness unconnected
scenarios.content_vi: Khi lắp/tháo giàn giáo chưa có sàn, công nhân ngã do chưa móc dây an toàn
scenarios.content_th: ขณะประกอบ/รื้อนั่งร้านที่ยังไม่มีพื้น ผู้ปฏิบัติงานตกเพราะไม่ได้คล้องเข็มขัด
scenarios.content_id: Saat pasang/bongkar perancah tanpa platform, pekerja jatuh karena harness tidak terkait

mitigations.content: 조립·해체 구간 하부 출입통제, 안전대 부착설비(수평구명줄) 선설치, 부재 손으로 던지기 금지·인양도구 사용, 강풍·악천후 중지
mitigations.content_en: Exclude area below, pre-install harness anchor (horizontal lifeline), ban hand-throwing members—use lifting tools, stop in high wind/bad weather
mitigations.content_vi: Cấm vùng dưới, lắp trước điểm neo (dây cứu sinh ngang), cấm ném cấu kiện—dùng dụng cụ nâng, ngừng khi gió mạnh/thời tiết xấu
mitigations.content_th: ห้ามเข้าด้านล่าง ติดจุดยึดล่วงหน้า (ไลฟ์ไลน์แนวนอน) ห้ามโยนชิ้นส่วน—ใช้อุปกรณ์ยก หยุดเมื่อลมแรง/อากาศแปรปรวน
mitigations.content_id: Larang area bawah, pasang anchor lebih dulu (lifeline horizontal), larang lempar tangan—gunakan alat angkat, hentikan saat angin/cuaca buruk

ppe.content: 안전모(턱끈) + 안전화 + 전신 안전대(2점 후크) + 보호장갑
ppe.content_en: Safety helmet (chin strap) + safety boots + full-body harness (double hook) + gloves
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ (quai cằm) + giày bảo hộ + dây an toàn toàn thân (móc đôi) + găng tay
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย (สายรัดคาง) + รองเท้านิรภัย + เข็มขัดนิรภัยเต็มตัว (ตะขอคู่) + ถุงมือ
ppe.content_id: Helm safety (tali dagu) + sepatu safety + full body harness (hook ganda) + sarung tangan

TOWERCRANE_LIFTING.label_th: การยกด้วยทาวเวอร์เครน

baseline.content: 타워크레인 운전·작업 전 점검 및 순간풍속 기준 초과 시 작업중지 확인
baseline.content_en: Pre-operation tower crane inspection and stop work when gust wind speed exceeds limit
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra cẩu tháp trước vận hành và dừng việc khi tốc độ gió giật vượt ngưỡng
baseline.content_th: ตรวจทาวเวอร์เครนก่อนใช้งานและหยุดงานเมื่อความเร็วลมกระโชกเกินกำหนด
baseline.content_id: Inspeksi tower crane pra-operasi dan hentikan kerja saat kecepatan angin kejut melampaui batas
baseline.regulation: 산업안전보건기준규칙 §37(악천후 및 강풍 시 작업중지 — 순간풍속 10m/s 설치·해체 중지, 15m/s 운전 중지), §140(폭풍에 의한 무너짐 방지)

scenarios.content: 순간풍속 15m/s 초과 중 양중 강행으로 인양물 흔들림·크레인 전도 위험
scenarios.content_en: Forcing a lift above 15 m/s gust causes load swing/crane overturn risk
scenarios.content_vi: Cố nâng khi gió giật >15 m/s gây tải lắc/nguy cơ lật cẩu
scenarios.content_th: ฝืนยกขณะลมกระโชก >15 ม./วิ ทำให้ของแกว่ง/เสี่ยงเครนล้ม
scenarios.content_id: Memaksa angkat saat angin >15 m/s menyebabkan beban berayun/risiko crane terguling

mitigations.content: 풍속계 모니터링(순간 15m/s 양중중지·평균 10m/s 주의·20m/s 설치해체 중지), 작업 전 권과방지·브레이크·와이어 점검, 운전원 자격 확인
mitigations.content_en: Monitor anemometer (stop lift at 15 m/s gust, caution at 10 m/s mean, stop erect/dismantle at 20 m/s); pre-check anti-two-block/brake/wire; verify operator license
mitigations.content_vi: Theo dõi máy đo gió (dừng nâng ở 15 m/s giật, chú ý 10 m/s trung bình, dừng lắp/tháo ở 20 m/s); kiểm tra chống cuốn/phanh/cáp; xác nhận chứng chỉ vận hành
mitigations.content_th: ตรวจเครื่องวัดลม (หยุดยกที่ 15 ม./วิ กระโชก ระวังที่ 10 ม./วิ เฉลี่ย หยุดติดตั้ง/รื้อที่ 20 ม./วิ) ตรวจกันม้วนเกิน/เบรก/ลวด ตรวจใบอนุญาตผู้ขับ
mitigations.content_id: Pantau anemometer (stop angkat 15 m/s kejut, waspada 10 m/s rata, stop pasang/bongkar 20 m/s); cek anti-two-block/rem/wire; verifikasi lisensi operator

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + harness (when climbing) + radio
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + dây an toàn (khi leo) + bộ đàm
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เข็มขัดนิรภัย (เมื่อปีน) + วิทยุสื่อสาร
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + harness (saat memanjat) + radio

baseline.content: 줄걸이(인양구) 점검 및 인양물 무게중심·결속 적정성 확인
baseline.content_en: Inspect rigging gear and verify load center of gravity and sling adequacy
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra thiết bị buộc tải và xác nhận trọng tâm tải và độ chắc dây buộc
baseline.content_th: ตรวจอุปกรณ์ผูกยกและตรวจจุดศูนย์ถ่วงและความเหมาะสมของการผูก
baseline.content_id: Inspeksi alat rigging dan verifikasi titik berat beban dan kelayakan sling
baseline.regulation: 산업안전보건기준규칙 §163(와이어로프 등 달기구의 안전계수), §166(이음매 있는 와이어로프 등 사용금지)

scenarios.content: 마모·손상된 슬링 사용 또는 무게중심 편심 결속으로 인양물 탈락·전도하여 하부 충돌
scenarios.content_en: Worn/damaged sling or off-center rigging drops/topples the load, striking workers below
scenarios.content_vi: Cáp mòn/hỏng hoặc buộc lệch tâm làm tải rơi/lật va người bên dưới
scenarios.content_th: สลิงสึก/ชำรุดหรือผูกเยื้องศูนย์ทำให้ของหลุด/พลิกชนด้านล่าง
scenarios.content_id: Sling aus/rusak atau rigging tidak seimbang membuat beban jatuh/terbalik menimpa di bawah

mitigations.content: 작업 전 슬링·샤클·후크 해지장치 점검(폐기기준 준수), 안전계수 충족·무게중심 결속, 자격 줄걸이공 배치, 시험인양(살짝 들기) 후 본인양
mitigations.content_en: Pre-check sling/shackle/hook latch (discard criteria), meet safety factor & balance load, assign certified rigger, trial lift (inch up) before full lift
mitigations.content_vi: Kiểm tra cáp/ma ní/chốt móc trước (tiêu chí loại bỏ), đạt hệ số an toàn & cân tải, bố trí thợ buộc có chứng chỉ, nâng thử trước khi nâng chính
mitigations.content_th: ตรวจสลิง/สเก็น/สลักตะขอก่อน (เกณฑ์ทิ้ง) ได้ค่าความปลอดภัย & สมดุล จัดช่างผูกมีใบรับรอง ทดลองยกก่อนยกจริง
mitigations.content_id: Cek sling/shackle/latch hook (kriteria buang), penuhi faktor keamanan & seimbangkan, tugaskan rigger bersertifikat, uji angkat sebelum angkat penuh

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + work gloves + hi-vis vest
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + găng tay + áo phản quang
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + ถุงมือ + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + sarung tangan + rompi hi-vis

baseline.content: 신호수 배치·신호체계 통일 및 인양물 하부 출입통제 확인
baseline.content_en: Confirm signaler assignment/unified signaling and exclusion of area below the load
baseline.content_vi: Xác nhận bố trí người ra hiệu/thống nhất tín hiệu và cấm vùng dưới tải
baseline.content_th: ยืนยันการจัดผู้ให้สัญญาณ/ระบบสัญญาณเดียวกันและห้ามเข้าด้านล่างของตรงที่ยก
baseline.content_id: Konfirmasi penugasan pemberi aba-aba/sinyal seragam dan larangan area di bawah beban

scenarios.content: 신호 혼선·무전 두절로 인양물이 작업자 머리 위로 통과·낙하하여 충돌
scenarios.content_en: Signal confusion/radio loss lets the load pass/fall over workers' heads, causing a strike
scenarios.content_vi: Nhiễu tín hiệu/mất bộ đàm khiến tải đi/rơi qua đầu công nhân gây va đập
scenarios.content_th: สัญญาณสับสน/วิทยุขาดทำให้ของยกผ่าน/ตกเหนือหัวผู้ปฏิบัติงานเกิดการชน
scenarios.content_id: Sinyal kacau/radio putus membuat beban lewat/jatuh di atas kepala pekerja menyebabkan benturan

mitigations.content: 전담 신호수 1인·표준수신호/무전 단일 채널, 인양 경로상 출입금지구역 설정, 인양물 하부 통과·체류 금지, 풍압면적 큰 물체 유도로프 사용
mitigations.content_en: One dedicated signaler/standard hand or single radio channel, set no-go zone along lift path, ban passing/standing under load, use tag line for large windage loads
mitigations.content_vi: 1 người ra hiệu chuyên trách/tín hiệu tay chuẩn hoặc 1 kênh bộ đàm, lập vùng cấm theo lộ trình, cấm đi/đứng dưới tải, dùng dây dẫn cho tải diện gió lớn
mitigations.content_th: ผู้ให้สัญญาณ 1 คน/สัญญาณมือมาตรฐานหรือช่องวิทยุเดียว ตั้งเขตห้ามตามเส้นทางยก ห้ามผ่าน/ยืนใต้ของยก ใช้เชือกนำสำหรับของรับลมมาก
mitigations.content_id: 1 pemberi aba-aba khusus/sinyal tangan standar atau 1 kanal radio, tetapkan zona larangan sepanjang jalur, larang lewat/berdiri di bawah beban, gunakan tag line untuk beban windage besar

ppe.content: 안전모 + 안전화 + 신호수 식별 조끼 + 무전기
ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + distinct signaler vest + radio
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + áo nhận diện người ra hiệu + bộ đàm
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เสื้อระบุผู้ให้สัญญาณ + วิทยุสื่อสาร
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + rompi pengenal aba-aba + radio

MEP_FINISHING.label_th: งานระบบ ไฟฟ้า และงานตกแต่ง

baseline.content: 가설전기 설비 감전예방 — 분전반 누전차단기·접지·전선 피복 및 우천 시 충전부 점검
baseline.content_en: Temporary electrical shock prevention — panel ELB/grounding/cable insulation and live-part check in rain
baseline.content_vi: Phòng điện giật điện tạm — ELB tủ điện/tiếp địa/vỏ dây và kiểm tra phần mang điện khi mưa
baseline.content_th: ป้องกันไฟดูดไฟฟ้าชั่วคราว — ELB ตู้/สายดิน/ฉนวนสายและตรวจส่วนมีไฟตอนฝน
baseline.content_id: Pencegahan sengatan listrik sementara — ELB panel/grounding/isolasi kabel dan cek bagian bertegangan saat hujan

scenarios.content: 누전차단기 미설치·접지 불량 분전반에서 젖은 손·물기 접촉으로 감전 사망
scenarios.content_en: Contact with wet hands on a panel lacking ELB/proper grounding causes fatal electric shock
scenarios.content_vi: Tiếp xúc tay ướt với tủ điện thiếu ELB/tiếp địa kém gây điện giật chết người
scenarios.content_th: สัมผัสด้วยมือเปียกที่ตู้ไม่มี ELB/สายดินไม่ดีทำให้ไฟดูดเสียชีวิต
scenarios.content_id: Kontak tangan basah pada panel tanpa ELB/grounding buruk menyebabkan sengatan fatal

mitigations.content: 분전반 누전차단기·접지 작동시험(월 1회 이상), 충전부 방호·잠금, 전선 가공·피복 점검, 우천 시 옥외 충전작업 중지
mitigations.content_en: Test panel ELB/grounding (≥monthly), guard/lock live parts, route/inspect cable insulation, stop outdoor live work in rain
mitigations.content_vi: Thử ELB/tiếp địa tủ (≥hằng tháng), che/khóa phần mang điện, đi/kiểm tra vỏ dây, ngừng việc mang điện ngoài trời khi mưa
mitigations.content_th: ทดสอบ ELB/สายดินตู้ (≥เดือนละครั้ง) ป้องกัน/ล็อกส่วนมีไฟ เดิน/ตรวจฉนวนสาย หยุดงานมีไฟกลางแจ้งตอนฝน
mitigations.content_id: Uji ELB/grounding panel (≥bulanan), lindungi/kunci bagian bertegangan, rute/cek isolasi kabel, hentikan kerja bertegangan luar saat hujan

ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + insulated safety boots + insulating gloves + safety goggles
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày cách điện + găng cách điện + kính bảo hộ
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัยฉนวน + ถุงมือฉนวน + แว่นตานิรภัย
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu isolasi + sarung tangan isolasi + kacamata safety

baseline.content: 화기작업(용접·절단·그라인딩) 불티 화재예방 및 화기작업 허가·감시인 배치
baseline.content_en: Hot work (welding/cutting/grinding) spark fire prevention with permit and fire watch
baseline.content_vi: Phòng cháy do tia lửa khi làm việc nóng (hàn/cắt/mài) với giấy phép và người canh lửa
baseline.content_th: ป้องกันไฟจากสะเก็ดงานร้อน (เชื่อม/ตัด/เจียร) พร้อมใบอนุญาตและผู้เฝ้าไฟ
baseline.content_id: Pencegahan kebakaran percikan kerja panas (las/potong/gerinda) dengan izin dan fire watch
baseline.regulation: 산업안전보건기준규칙 §241(화재위험작업 시의 준수사항), §232(폭발 또는 화재 등의 예방)

scenarios.content: 마감자재(우레탄·스티로폼·단열재) 인접 용접 불티가 비산하여 화재·유독가스 발생
scenarios.content_en: Welding sparks near finishing materials (urethane/styrofoam/insulation) ignite fire and toxic smoke
scenarios.content_vi: Tia lửa hàn gần vật liệu hoàn thiện (urethane/xốp/cách nhiệt) gây cháy và khói độc
scenarios.content_th: สะเก็ดเชื่อมใกล้วัสดุตกแต่ง (ยูรีเทน/โฟม/ฉนวน) จุดไฟและควันพิษ
scenarios.content_id: Percikan las dekat material finishing (uretan/styrofoam/insulasi) memicu api dan asap beracun

mitigations.content: 화기작업 허가서·가연물 이격/불연포 차단, 소화기·소화수 비치, 화재감시인 작업 중·종료 후 30분 잔불 감시, 작업장 가스농도 측정
mitigations.content_en: Hot work permit/clear or shield combustibles with fire blanket, provide extinguisher/water, fire watch during + 30 min after, measure area gas
mitigations.content_vi: Giấy phép việc nóng/dọn hoặc che vật cháy bằng chăn chống cháy, có bình/nước chữa cháy, canh lửa trong + 30 phút sau, đo khí khu vực
mitigations.content_th: ใบอนุญาตงานร้อน/เคลียร์หรือคลุมวัสดุไวไฟด้วยผ้ากันไฟ มีถังดับเพลิง/น้ำ เฝ้าไฟระหว่าง + 30 นาทีหลัง วัดก๊าซพื้นที่
mitigations.content_id: Izin kerja panas/jauhkan atau tutup bahan mudah terbakar dengan fire blanket, sediakan APAR/air, fire watch selama + 30 menit sesudah, ukur gas area

ppe.content: 용접면 + 방염 작업복·앞치마 + 용접장갑 + 안전화 + 방진/방연 마스크
ppe.content_en: Welding shield + flame-retardant clothing/apron + welding gloves + safety boots + dust/fume mask
ppe.content_vi: Mặt nạ hàn + quần áo/tạp dề chống cháy + găng hàn + giày bảo hộ + khẩu trang chống bụi/khói
ppe.content_th: หน้ากากเชื่อม + ชุด/ผ้ากันเปื้อนกันไฟ + ถุงมือเชื่อม + รองเท้านิรภัย + หน้ากากกันฝุ่น/ควัน
ppe.content_id: Topeng las + pakaian/celemek tahan api + sarung tangan las + sepatu safety + masker debu/asap

baseline.content: 밀폐공간(정화조·집수정·PIT·물탱크) 작업 전 산소·유해가스 측정 및 환기·감시인 확인
baseline.content_en: Confined space (septic/sump/pit/water tank) pre-work gas measurement, ventilation and attendant
baseline.content_vi: Không gian kín (bể tự hoại/hố thu/PIT/bể nước) đo khí trước, thông gió và người canh
baseline.content_th: พื้นที่อับอากาศ (บ่อเกรอะ/บ่อรวม/PIT/ถังน้ำ) วัดก๊าซก่อน ระบายอากาศและผู้เฝ้า
baseline.content_id: Ruang terbatas (septik/sump/pit/tangki air) ukur gas pra-kerja, ventilasi dan pengawas

scenarios.content: 환기·측정 없이 밀폐공간 진입하여 산소결핍·황화수소 중독으로 쓰러지고 무리한 구조로 2차 재해
scenarios.content_en: Entering confined space without ventilation/measurement causes O2 deficiency/H2S poisoning, with secondary harm from reckless rescue
scenarios.content_vi: Vào không gian kín không thông gió/đo gây thiếu O2/ngộ độc H2S, cứu hộ liều lĩnh gây tai nạn thứ cấp
scenarios.content_th: เข้าพื้นที่อับอากาศโดยไม่ระบาย/วัดทำให้ขาด O2/พิษ H2S ล้ม และช่วยเหลือผลีผลามเกิดเหตุซ้ำ
scenarios.content_id: Masuk ruang terbatas tanpa ventilasi/ukur menyebabkan defisit O2/keracunan H2S, dan korban sekunder dari penyelamatan nekat

mitigations.content: 진입 전 산소(18~23.5%)·황화수소·일산화탄소·가연성 측정, 연속 환기, 감시인 상시 배치, 송기마스크·구조장비(삼각대·구명로프) 비치, 무허가 진입금지
mitigations.content_en: Pre-entry measure O2 (18–23.5%)/H2S/CO/flammable, continuous ventilation, standby attendant, supplied-air mask + rescue gear (tripod/lifeline), no entry without permit
mitigations.content_vi: Trước khi vào đo O2 (18–23.5%)/H2S/CO/khí cháy, thông gió liên tục, có người canh, mặt nạ cấp khí + thiết bị cứu (giá ba chân/dây cứu), cấm vào không phép
mitigations.content_th: ก่อนเข้าวัด O2 (18–23.5%)/H2S/CO/ก๊าซไวไฟ ระบายต่อเนื่อง มีผู้เฝ้า หน้ากากจ่ายอากาศ + อุปกรณ์กู้ภัย (ขาตั้ง/เชือกชูชีพ) ห้ามเข้าโดยไม่อนุญาต
mitigations.content_id: Sebelum masuk ukur O2 (18–23.5%)/H2S/CO/mudah terbakar, ventilasi terus, pengawas siaga, masker suplai udara + alat rescue (tripod/lifeline), larang masuk tanpa izin

ppe.content: 송기마스크 또는 공기호흡기 + 전신 안전대(구명줄 연결) + 안전모 + 가스측정기
ppe.content_en: Supplied-air mask or SCBA + full-body harness (lifeline) + safety helmet + gas detector
ppe.content_vi: Mặt nạ cấp khí hoặc SCBA + dây an toàn toàn thân (dây cứu) + mũ bảo hộ + máy đo khí
ppe.content_th: หน้ากากจ่ายอากาศหรือ SCBA + เข็มขัดนิรภัยเต็มตัว (เชือกชูชีพ) + หมวกนิรภัย + เครื่องวัดก๊าซ
ppe.content_id: Masker suplai udara atau SCBA + full body harness (lifeline) + helm safety + detektor gas

baseline.content: 내부 마감·도장·설비 고소작업 시 이동식비계·말비계 안정 및 추락방지 확인
baseline.content_en: Verify mobile/step scaffold stability and fall protection during interior finishing/painting/MEP at height
baseline.content_vi: Kiểm tra ổn định giàn giáo di động/giàn thấp và chống rơi khi hoàn thiện/sơn/cơ điện trên cao
baseline.content_th: ตรวจความมั่นคงของนั่งร้านเคลื่อนที่/ม้ายืนและการป้องกันตกขณะงานตกแต่ง/ทาสี/ระบบที่สูง
baseline.content_id: Verifikasi stabilitas perancah mobile/step dan proteksi jatuh saat finishing/cat/MEP di ketinggian

scenarios.content: 이동식비계 아웃트리거 미전개·바퀴 미고정 상태에서 이동·작업 중 전도하여 작업자 추락
scenarios.content_en: Mobile scaffold tips during move/work with outriggers not deployed/wheels unlocked, causing a fall
scenarios.content_vi: Giàn giáo di động lật khi di chuyển/làm việc do chưa mở chân chống/chưa khóa bánh, gây ngã
scenarios.content_th: นั่งร้านเคลื่อนที่ล้มขณะเคลื่อน/ทำงานเพราะไม่กางขาค้ำ/ไม่ล็อกล้อ ทำให้ตก
scenarios.content_id: Perancah mobile terguling saat pindah/kerja karena outrigger tidak dipasang/roda tidak dikunci, menyebabkan jatuh

mitigations.content: 이동식비계 아웃트리거 전개·바퀴 고정 후 탑승, 탑승 중 이동 금지, 작업발판 안전난간·승강설비 사용, 말비계 3단 이하·평탄 바닥
mitigations.content_en: Deploy outriggers/lock wheels before boarding, no riding while moving, use guardrail/proper access, step stool ≤3 steps on level floor
mitigations.content_vi: Mở chân chống/khóa bánh trước khi lên, cấm di chuyển khi đang đứng trên, dùng lan can/lối lên, giàn thấp ≤3 bậc trên nền phẳng
mitigations.content_th: กางขาค้ำ/ล็อกล้อก่อนขึ้น ห้ามเคลื่อนขณะมีคนอยู่บน ใช้ราวกัน/ทางขึ้น ม้ายืน ≤3 ขั้นบนพื้นราบ
mitigations.content_id: Pasang outrigger/kunci roda sebelum naik, larang pindah saat ditumpangi, gunakan railing/akses, step ≤3 anak tangga di lantai rata

ppe.content: 안전모 + 안전화 + 전신 안전대 + (도장 시) 방독마스크·보안경
ppe.content_en: Safety helmet + safety boots + full-body harness + (painting) respirator/goggles
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + dây an toàn toàn thân + (khi sơn) mặt nạ phòng độc/kính
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เข็มขัดนิรภัยเต็มตัว + (ทาสี) หน้ากากกันไอ/แว่นตา
ppe.content_id: Helm safety + sepatu safety + full body harness + (mengecat) respirator/kacamata
